items.title: Covered Pines Campgrounds (Film)
items.comment: The second novel has problems and contradicts itself, we shouldn't take the contradicting info in the novels too literally.
items.summary: Covered Pines Campgrounds is a major location in the 2023 film Five Nights at Freddy's.  The location is where Michael Schmidt witnessed his younger brother, Garrett Schmidt get kidnapped and is where all his dreams take place.

items.title: Freddy Fazbear
items.summary: Freddy Fazbear is the titular antagonist of the Five Nights at Freddy's series and the main of the four original animatronics of Freddy Fazbear's Pizza.

items.title: The Office (FNaF2)
items.summary: The Office is a location within Freddy Fazbear's Pizza and is the central location of Five Nights at Freddy's 2.  As in the first, third, and seventh games, the Office is the only room that the player inhabits.
